pristine.sourcePolicy: Byte-exact upstream typecheck (tsc --noEmit) over vendored src/index.ts + src/index.test.ts, including the @ts-expect-error at index.test.ts:392.

pristineProbes.sourcePolicy: Repo-authored React declaration probes compiled with tsc against the vendored react-alien-signals surface.

adapted.sourcePolicy: One-for-one adapted assertion groups for the upstream typecheck artifact plus supplemental public-api probes after permitted import-root transforms.

permittedTransformations.rule: React probes import vendored upstream/src; Octane probes import @octanejs/alien-signals
Upstream typecheck assertions live in src/index.test.ts; adapted counterparts may use a BunMatchers stand-in so the same @ts-expect-error next-line group typechecks under tsrx-tsc
Matching @ts-expect-error and expectType groups must reject or accept the same shapes on both sides

upstreamTypecheck assertion-groups pairs also inventory every accepted public-API call occurrence from the pinned upstream type suite as a multiset; adapted must match one-for-one so dropping a duplicate accepted call while another remains is rejected

notes: Upstream ships an executable typecheck suite via package.json typecheck → tsc --noEmit and the pinned tsconfig (src/index.ts + src/index.test.ts). The adapted upstream-typecheck counterpart pins the @ts-expect-error group plus the full accepted public-API call multiset from that suite. Repo-authored public-api probes are a required pristine type lane (audit/type-probes/tsconfig.pristine.json) and are mechanically required to belong to that compiler program; adapted counterparts compile under typetests/tsconfig.adapted.json. Computed-signal acceptance for useSignalValue is an Octane-only divergence (alien-signals-readable-computed) compiled by the ordinary package typecheck, not the adapted-types parity project.

divergences.rule: Paired probes keep useSignalValue(count); readable computed acceptance lives in typetests/readable-computed.test-d.ts under ordinary package typecheck
